verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a skills package and CLI tool like YYLO Skills, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out control. The isolated configuration directory is for validating an unpublished checkout, not for privacy, so it does not count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
